ios.desc:
Mallo is an AI companion that remembers you—your name, your wins, what you're working through—and checks in with you so the relationship feels real. Built for anyone living alone, relocated, or working remotely who wants a daily ritual that gets deeper each week.

• Chat every day — Talk about your day, mood, or anything on your mind. Mallo responds with warmth and consistency. Free tier includes limited messages; more require a subscription.
• Memory that matters — Your conversations and the things you care about are remembered. Mallo references them over time so the relationship feels real. Expanded memory and Memory Book require a subscription.
• Daily check-ins (in-app purchase required) — Gentle, proactive check-ins are included only with a paid Silver or Gold subscription and help you stay connected without feeling spammy.
• Subscriptions (in-app purchase) — Free to start. Optional paid subscriptions: Bronze (Memory Starter), Silver (Daily Check-ins), and Gold (No Ceilings) unlock more messages, memories, and features such as photo recognition and voice. Silver offers a free trial. Purchase required to access these tiers.

Mallo is a companion for reflection and connection. It is not a substitute for professional mental health care, diagnosis, or treatment. If you’re in crisis, please reach out to a qualified professional or crisis service.

Download free. Premium features require an in-app subscription. Privacy Policy: https://mallopal.com/privacy. Terms of Use (EULA): https://mallopal.com/terms.

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built Mallo, an iOS AI companion that remembers you and proactively checks in with you every day.

### What it is

Mallo is a chat-based companion app for iOS. You talk to it like you would to a friend: about your day, your worries, your goals, or even trivial things. Under the hood, it:

- extracts long-term memories from your conversations (people, events, preferences, recurring topics),
- stores them in a structured way, and
- uses them in future chats so it can say things like “How did that interview go?” or “You mentioned you’ve been feeling burned out recently—how are you now?”

The second piece is proactive behavior. Instead of waiting for you to open the app, Mallo:

- schedules daily greetings and check-ins,
- sends “streak rescue” nudges if you’re about to break your streak,
- can follow up after emotionally significant days.

So it’s not just a generic “ask me anything” chatbot—it’s trying to be a lightweight, long-term companion.

### Why I built it

I’ve been working remotely for a long time and building products mostly by myself. I noticed a recurring pattern: I’d have days where I just wanted some light emotional support or a feeling of “someone is here with me,” but:

- traditional social apps felt noisy and performative,
- therapy (while hugely valuable) has a higher barrier to entry and a different cadence,
- and generic LLM chat apps felt like tools, not companions: every conversation started from zero, and they never reached out first.
